name: UAL 805 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动 导航/自动驾驶问题

cards.audioText: Your call sign is UAL 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching WXI, maintaining 11,000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 UAL 805，正飞往广州，接近 WXI，保持 11,000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, approaching WXI, maintaining 2000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，接近 WXI，保持 2000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，雷达识别，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，因武汉管制限制将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: offset tree miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，将速度减至 Mach 0.75，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, our weather radar indicates there is a thunderstorm ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，我们气象雷达显示前方有雷暴，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 805。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, reduce speed to mach decimal 72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control mach decimal 72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 805，将速度减至 Mach 0.72。
B： 通知郑州管制，Mach 0.72 不可接受，对你的航空器而言太低。
cards.referenceText: negative, mach decimal seven two is not acceptable due it's too low, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，Mach 0.72不可接受，因为太低，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, Zhengzhou Control, maintain mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，郑州管制，保持 Mach 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的航空器数量。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 805, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 0638Z.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 805，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 0638Z 到达 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646。
cards.referenceText: Orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 0646, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 0646，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed the orbit, ask Zhengzhou Control to track direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成盘旋，请求郑州管制直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, request track direct to OBLIK.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，请求直飞 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: UAL 805, direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461。
cards.referenceText: direct to OBLIK, turn left heading 130 to intercept Amber 461, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 OBLIK，左转航向 130，切入 Amber 461，UAL 805。

cards.audioText: UAL 80550 miles to OBLIK, contact Wuhan Control on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 805，距 OBLIK 50 英里，联系武汉管制 118.9。

cards.audioText: you are over OBLIK at time 0646, maintaining 11,000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 0658, your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 0646 时飞越 OBLIK，保持 11,000 米，预计 0658 时到达 ZF，下一个航路点是 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 805, over OBLIK 0646, 2000 meters, estimating ZF0658, next WUH.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 805，0646 飞越 OBLIK，2000 米，预计 0658 到达 ZF，下一个航路点 WUH。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, roger, maintain 11000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，收到，保持 11000 米，报告 ZF。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar failure, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达故障，为识别，重设应答机 3572。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar identified, resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 805，雷达已识别，恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO。
cards.referenceText: Resume own navigation, track direct to DAPRO, UAL 805.
cards.referenceTextZh: 恢复自主导航，直飞 DAPRO，UAL 805。
